display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-08 Co-funding Strategic Energy Technology (SET) Plan renewable fuel value chains at EU, national, regional, and local level – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-08 Co-funding Strategic Energy Technology (SET) Plan renewable fuel value chains at EU, national, regional, and local level
executive_summary: A Horizon Europe Programme Co-fund Action (a joint programme run by organisations that manage or fund national or regional research programmes) of about 5 years that organises annual joint transnational calls and passes grants of up to EUR 500,000 per third party on to research and innovation projects along renewable fuel value chains under the SET Plan (the EU Strategic Energy Technology Plan). The funding rate is 70%; the topic budget is EUR 30 million for around one project. Hydrogen as an end product and heat and power production are out of scope. Single-stage; opens 3 December 2026, deadline 31 March 2027 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme 2026-2027 (Part 8), pp. 129–132, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope, funds a co-fund programme of research funders that runs joint calls for renewable fuel research and demonstration (advanced biofuels, renewable fuels of non-biological origin, intermediate bioenergy carriers), and General Annex B limits Programme Co-fund actions to entities managing or funding research programmes. It does not touch TenneT's field: no project file is close to it, and the topic explicitly excludes heat and power production and hydrogen as an end product, leaving no link to electricity transmission, grid operation or markets.
